labels.A: a willing answer asks for the task, the place or the means before placing
labels.B: a joining answer reports a part, explains itself or renews the call
labels.C: the caller widens or orients the call: a sticky, an official title, video posts, other chats, a landmark
labels.D: the call redirected, divided or refused
labels.Q: the cited words include an answer that asks something back of the caller
